idea-plugin.name: Ansible Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Ansible Vault, FQCN completion and safety checks for Ansible YAML, with no ansible-vault, ansible-lint or ansible-core binary required. Everything runs inside the IDE: no network calls, no telemetry.

Free

  • Ansible Vault in the editor: encrypt a selection as an Ansible Vault 1.1/AES256 block, or decrypt one, from the editor's context menu. The password is never saved or cached.
  • Ansible-only file detection: playbooks and role files are recognized by path and content, so Kubernetes, Helm and Docker Compose YAML keep their own editors.

Ansible Companion Pro (paid, with a free trial)

  • FQCN-aware completion for 649 modules: ansible.builtin.*, community.general.* and ansible.posix.*.
  • Jinja2 highlighting for {{ }}, {% %} and {# #} inside Ansible YAML.
  • Role navigation: Ctrl+Click (or Ctrl+B) on a role reference opens its tasks/main.yml.
  • 9 safety checks, evaluated statically and working natively on Windows:
    • password-shaped arguments without no_log (CVE-2021-20191), and vault-shaped include_vars without no_log (CVE-2024-8775);
    • hardcoded validate_certs: false;
    • files created without an explicit mode, and unquoted octal modes such as mode: 755;
    • shell pipelines without pipefail;
    • state: latest on package managers, git checkouts of HEAD, and a dict or list as copy's content.
  • ansible-core 2.20 migration: facts used as top-level variables (ansible_os_family, ansible_distribution, ...) are flagged, with a quick-fix to ansible_facts.os_family, before ansible-core 2.24 stops injecting them.

The ansible-core 2.20 migration check was free before version 2026.6.0. Any installation that runs version 2026.6.0 or later before November 2, 2026 keeps it without a license.
